title: Day 7: Sequences, Time Series & Language Models
subtitle: Vanishing Gradients, LSTM Gating (Forget/Input/Output), Deep Autoencoder Anomaly Detection & Word2Vec Vector Arithmetic
duration: 4 Hours (6 Levels + 4 Interactive Studios + 10 Slide Quizzes)
summary: Master sequence processing, temporal memory, and sensory compression. Analyze why Vanilla RNNs suffer from vanishing gradients and explore how LSTM hydraulic gates (Forget, Input, Candidate, Output) preserve long-term temporal dependencies. Detect subtle sensory anomalies using Deep Bottleneck Autoencoders on the Smart Fish Tank benchmark. Experience semantic vector arithmetic with Word2Vec and GloVe.
